items.title: Uniform fractional moments of the integer-friendly truncation N_x: E[(x/N_x)^alpha s(N_x)^beta] is bounded
items.author: Tony Haddad; Dimitris Koukoulopoulos
items.work: On Arratia's coupling and the Dirichlet law for the factors of a random integer
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled lemma `lem:properties of N` at source lines 517-523: for fixed alpha in [0,1) and beta in [0,1/2) the quantity E[(x/N_x)^alpha s(N_x)^beta] is bounded uniformly in x. The author's proof (source lines 525-537) replaces the probabilistic statement by the tail sum S over n <= x of (x/n)^alpha s(n)^beta (lines 526-528), then performs an explicit divisor decomposition n = a*b with b = s(n) square-full (line 529), an inner partial-sum estimate that consumes alpha < 1 (lines 531-532), a cancellation of powers of b (line 533) and finally a convergence argument for the square-full series that consumes beta < 1/2 (lines 535-536). The two parameter hypotheses are used at two different places, and neither the decomposition nor the cancellation is indicated by the statement.

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the lemma, retained line for line

contexts.label: the display defining Theta_x, the sum over the points of the underlying Poisson process that both the statement of the surrounding reduction and this proof refer to
